Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 8

“Perform your prescribed duty, for action is better than inaction. Even the maintenance of your body could not be accomplished without action.”

Krishna grounds the argument in something undeniable — a body has to be fed and kept. Even the would-be renunciate is sustained by work, whether or not he does it himself.
